title: The Long Report
story: Noor's report spans many pages, while Pace's summary claims nobody reviewed its first or last section. The player pages with Caps plus U and D and jumps with Caps plus T and G, citing the facts Pace left out. Light reaches the upper desk and the review chamber door opens.

steps.objective: Walk to the long-report terminal in the gallery.
Read forward a page at a time to the first fact.
Go back a page at a time to the second fact.
Check the first section of the report.
Check the last section of the report.
Answer a question about a changed report.
Cite a fact in an unmarked report.
Watch the light reach the upper desk and the review chamber door open.
Inspect the uncut index on the gallery lectern.

gestures.note: Plain u, d, t and g typed after Caps release.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Read forward a page at a time with Page Down, Caps plus D, to the first fact.
success_criteria: Page Down is observed twice and the viewport indicator rests on page 3

task.prompt: The report has six pages and a viewport indicator. Guided page markers lead to the first fact on page 3. Cite it.

items.fact: Fact A: route 4A takes two steps
items.citation: select the fact line and confirm

feedback.too_far: Command + Down jumped to the end of the document, not one page. Page Down moves one page.

task.layout: Keyboard diagram highlights Caps and D; viewport indicator shows page motion.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Go back a page at a time with Page Up, Caps plus U, to the second fact.
success_criteria: Page Up is observed and the viewport indicator rests on page 4

task.prompt: From page 6, go back to the second fact on page 4. Cite it.

items.fact: Fact B: the rename had no staff request
items.citation: select the fact line and confirm

feedback.wrong_way: Page Down moved forward. Page Up goes back.

task.layout: Keyboard diagram highlights Caps and U.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Check the first section with Command plus Up, Caps plus T.
success_criteria: Command + Up is observed and the cursor is in section 1
The section 1 reviewer line is cited

task.prompt: Pace's summary claims nobody reviewed the first section. Jump to the start of the document and cite who reviewed it.

items.fact: Section 1: reviewed by staff on 14 March
items.citation: select the reviewer line and confirm

rejects: Page Up pressed repeatedly is allowed but recorded as page steps

feedback.t_typed: A t was typed while Caps was held and became a jump. Release Caps to type a letter.

task.layout: Keyboard diagram highlights Caps and T.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Check the last section with Command plus Down, Caps plus G.
success_criteria: Command + Down is observed and the cursor is in the last section
The last section's reviewer line is cited

task.prompt: Jump to the end of the document and cite who reviewed the last section.

items.fact: Section 6: reviewed by staff on 2 April
items.citation: select the reviewer line and confirm

rejects: Page Down pressed repeatedly is allowed but recorded as page steps

feedback.g_typed: A g was typed while Caps was held and became a jump. Release Caps to type a letter.

task.layout: Keyboard diagram highlights Caps and G.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Answer a question about a changed report by mixing page and document jumps, then type plain u, d, t and g after Caps is released.
success_criteria: Both facts are cited and the citation tag reads 'udtg'
The letters u, d, t and g were typed as text after Caps was released

task.prompt: A different report, six pages again: cite the fact on page 5 and the last section's closing line, then type the citation tag.

items.fact: Fact C: the detour was scored as movement
items.citation: select the fact line and confirm
select the closing line and confirm

rejects: a letter typed while Caps is held

feedback.held: A letter was pressed while Caps was held and became a jump. Release Caps to type it.

task.layout: Viewport indicator only; no keyboard diagram.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Cite a fact at an unmarked location with no positional hint.
success_criteria: The requested fact is cited from a report with no page markers
No keyboard diagram or viewport markers were shown

task.prompt: A third report. Cite the sentence that names who changed the department name.

items.fact: Page 7: the rename was entered without a staff request

feedback.lost: The viewport indicator is hidden here; use page or document jumps to reach the sentence.

task.layout: No keyboard diagram and no viewport indicator.

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: To read the next page, you need to press Page Down. Hint: Page Down is tap-hold Caps + D.

hint.action: To read the next page, you need to press Page Down.
hint.gesture: Page Down is tap-hold Caps + D.

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: To go back a page, you need to press Page Up. Hint: Page Up is tap-hold Caps + U.

hint.action: To go back a page, you need to press Page Up.
hint.gesture: Page Up is tap-hold Caps + U.

dialogue.speaker: report_tab
dialogue.text: To check the first section, you need to press Command + Up. Hint: Command + Up is tap-hold Caps + T.

hint.action: To check the first section, you need to press Command + Up.
hint.gesture: Command + Up is tap-hold Caps + T.

dialogue.speaker: report_tab
dialogue.text: To check the last section, you need to press Command + Down. Hint: Command + Down is tap-hold Caps + G.

hint.action: To check the last section, you need to press Command + Down.
hint.gesture: Command + Down is tap-hold Caps + G.

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: Pace's summary says nobody reviewed the first or the last section. I have the reviewers' lines. Both of them.
dialogue.cue: 10: noor_unimpressed at the summary that says nobody reviewed it

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Uncut index: the department name changed here, and nothing in the file shows a staff request.
dialogue.cue: Engineer: concerned when inspecting a tampering artifact (Uncut index)

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: There. The original report beside the summary. Read them side by side.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Journal: Caps+D and Caps+U move by page; Caps+T and Caps+G move by document. The upper desk has light again.

then.text: Page and document jumps cited both reviewers; the review chamber is open.

state_changes.before: The gallery's upper desk is dark and the review chamber door at the east end is shut.
state_changes.after: The upper desk lamp is lit, the review chamber door has slid open and Noor waits inside beside the original report.

visible_changes.note: Places the original report, then waits in the chamber.

optional_artifact.name: Uncut index
caption: Uncut index: the department's original name, in the index's own ink.
No staff request is attached to the rename.
Someone changed it, and nobody asked.

pace_copy.text: Summary: the first and last sections were not reviewed.

review_notes: Checked at 1366x768 (x4) with the keyboard inset open (stage x 16-588, y 412-704; logical x 4-147, y 103-176).
